entries.task_id: this regulation|lays|down rules on watercraft identification
entries.description: This Regulation lays down rules on watercraft identification
entries.subject: This Regulation
entries.object: down rules on watercraft identification

spans.text: This Regulation lays down rules on watercraft identification, in particular rules on assignment and administration of manufacturer's codes.

entries.task_id: the|following|definitions shall apply:
entries.description: the following definitions shall apply:
entries.subject: the
entries.object: definitions shall apply:

spans.text: For the purpose of this Regulation, the following definitions shall apply:

entries.task_id: the manufacturer|is|established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office
entries.description: the manufacturer is established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office
entries.subject: the manufacturer
entries.object: established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office

spans.text: (b) ‘country where the manufacturer is established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office, in case of a legal person, or a permanent address, in case of a natural person;
(a) the country code of the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established;

entries.task_id: national|register’|means the register of each member state where the unique code of manufacturer for the manufacturers established in their territory is recorded
entries.description: national register’ means the register of each Member State where the unique code of manufacturer for the manufacturers established in their territory is recorded
entries.subject: national
entries.object: means the register of each Member State where the unique code of manufacturer for the manufacturers established in their territory is recorded

spans.text: (c) ‘national register’ means the register of each Member State where the unique code of manufacturer for the manufacturers established in their territory is recorded;

entries.task_id: third country|register’|means the register of the commission collaborative platform where the unique code of manufacturer for manufacturers established in third countries is recorded
entries.description: third country register’ means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the unique code of manufacturer for manufacturers established in third countries is recorded
entries.subject: third country
entries.object: means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the unique code of manufacturer for manufacturers established in third countries is recorded

spans.text: (d) ‘third country register’ means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the unique code of manufacturer for manufacturers established in third countries is recorded;

entries.task_id: member states|register’|means the compilation of national registers in the commission collaborative platform
entries.description: Member States register’ means the compilation of national registers in the Commission collaborative platform
entries.subject: Member States
entries.object: means the compilation of national registers in the Commission collaborative platform

spans.text: (e) ‘Member States register’ means the compilation of national registers in the Commission collaborative platform;

entries.task_id: notified bodies'|register’|means the register of the commission collaborative platform where the post-construction assessment identification code is recorded
entries.description: notified bodies' register’ means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the post-construction assessment identification code is recorded
entries.subject: notified bodies'
entries.object: means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the post-construction assessment identification code is recorded

spans.text: (f) ‘notified bodies' register’ means the register of the Commission collaborative platform where the post-construction assessment identification code is recorded.

entries.task_id: identification number|shall|consist of the following elements in the following order:
entries.description: identification number shall consist of the following elements in the following order:
entries.subject: identification number
entries.object: consist of the following elements in the following order:

spans.text: A watercraft identification number (WIN) shall consist of the following elements in the following order:

entries.task_id: member state|may|also be generated by a national authority or national body of another member state with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer
entries.description: Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: Member State
entries.object: also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer

spans.text: (b) the unique code of the manufacturer assigned by the national authority of a Member State; however the same combination of characters to form a unique code for a manufacturer generated by a national authority or national body of one Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer;

entries.task_id: of characters|may|be used also by another manufacturer with the distinctive element being the combination with the unique code of manufacturer and the country code of the manufacturer
entries.description: of characters may be used also by another manufacturer with the distinctive element being the combination with the unique code of manufacturer and the country code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: of characters
entries.object: be used also by another manufacturer with the distinctive element being the combination with the unique code of manufacturer and the country code of the manufacturer

spans.text: (c) a unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer for identification of the watercraft and used only once by that manufacturer; however the same combination of characters may be used also by another manufacturer with the distinctive element being the combination with the unique code of manufacturer and the country code of the manufacturer;

entries.task_id: specific watercraft|is|intended to be placed on the market
entries.description: specific watercraft is intended to be placed on the market
entries.subject: specific watercraft
entries.object: intended to be placed on the market

spans.text: (e) model year which corresponds to the year when the specific watercraft is intended to be placed on the market.

entries.task_id: the win|shall|comply with the second paragraph of point 2
entries.description: the WIN shall comply with the second paragraph of Point 2
entries.subject: the WIN
entries.object: comply with the second paragraph of Point 2

spans.text: The composition of the WIN shall comply with the second paragraph of Point 2.1 of Annex I to Directive 2013/53/EU.

entries.task_id: the manufacturer|shall|be assigned by the national authority or national body of the member state following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with article 6 or 7
entries.description: the manufacturer shall be assigned by the national authority or national body of the Member State following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with Article 6 or 7
entries.subject: the manufacturer
entries.object: be assigned by the national authority or national body of the Member State following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with Article 6 or 7

spans.text: The unique code of the manufacturer shall be assigned by the national authority or national body of the Member State following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with Article 6 or 7.
The unique code for a manufacturer shall be generated and assigned only once by the national authority or national body of a Member State.

entries.task_id: each manufacturer|shall|have only one unique code for use over the union market
entries.description: Each manufacturer shall have only one unique code for use over the Union market
entries.subject: Each manufacturer
entries.object: have only one unique code for use over the Union market

spans.text: Each manufacturer shall have only one unique code for use over the Union market.

entries.task_id: member state|shall|designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.description: Member State shall designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: Member State
entries.object: designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer

spans.text: Each Member State shall designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall communicate to the Commission the national authority or the national body authorised for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall ensure that the unique code of the manufacturer is registered in their national register.

entries.task_id: the application|is|introduced as determined by the authority
entries.description: the application is introduced as determined by the authority
entries.subject: the application
entries.object: introduced as determined by the authority

spans.text: A manufacturer shall, before placing a watercraft on the Union market, submit an application, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority where the application is introduced as determined by the authority, for the assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer, to the national authority or national body in the Member State which it is established.

The application referred to in paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by a copy of a document that proves that the manufacturer is established in its Member State, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority where the application is introduced, as determined by the authority.

A manufacturer established in a third country or its authorised representative shall, before placing a watercraft on the Union market, submit an application, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority where the application is introduced as determined by the authority, for the assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer to the national authority or national body of the Member State, in which territory the manufacturer intends to place the watercraft on the market.
